response.sql: WITH ratios AS (SELECT p.SEX, CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> ''), group_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM group_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT g.avg_ratio FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f WHERE g.avg_ratio > f.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM first_kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.avg_ratio FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s WHERE k.avg_ratio > s.value) SELECT AVG(r.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(r.avg_ratio - f.value) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(r.avg_ratio - s.value) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM remaining AS r CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s;
